# corral + netstead documentation

Generated from the mkdocs nav for AI-agent consumption. Each link below points at the canonical rendered page.

## netstead docs

- [Home](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/netstead/index.md): netstead overview + install.
- [Quickstart](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/netstead/quickstart.md): Load the bundled Leavenworth fixture and run validation in 5 minutes.
- [What is GMNS?](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/netstead/what-is-gmns.md): Plain-English intro to the spec.
- [Visual tour](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/netstead/visual-tour.md): Leavenworth rendered as map + validation + edit + scope.

## Cookbook

- [Cookbook](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/netstead/cookbook/index.md): GMNS-specific recipes — validate, scope, edit, host, drive from AI.

- [Table of tables](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/netstead/reference/table-of-tables.md): Every GMNS table with purpose + FK diagram.
- [Glossary](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/netstead/reference/glossary.md): GMNS terms + project conventions.
